text:
alex: quick found a wording/behavior mismatch in the Dedicated SLA section under 'isolation and preemption' — docs say 'no preemption for reserved pools' but runtime still allows eviction when node is reclaimed
rachel: ouch. do we have an issue or PR for that?
alex: opened issue #4876 and a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4876 — but it's mostly wording. the bigger problem is the example YAML in the migration guide uses `preemptible: false` which the runtime ignores unless `eviction_policy` is set
toni: can you paste the snippet and the runtime expectation?
alex: snippet from docs migration guide:
```yaml
capacity_pool:
  reserved: true
  preemptible: false
  labels:
    - tenant: analytics
```
alex: runtime expects `eviction_policy` with explicit enum values (ALLOW_EVICT, NO_EVICT) and `isolation_decorators` vs `labels` changes matter for scheduling
rachel: so we should: 1) update the YAML examples to runtime schema, 2) add a one-paragraph migration note explaining mapping, 3) add an SDK snippet showing how to construct the pool programmatically and warn about fallback behavior
toni: agree. also request adding a small integration test that simulates node reclaim and verifies tenant pool isn't evicted when `NO_EVICT` is set — catches regressions
alex: i'll update the PR with a corrected YAML and the migration paragraph. proposing corrected snippet:
```yaml
capacity_pool:
  reserved: true
  eviction_policy: NO_EVICT
  isolation_decorators:
    - tenant: analytics
```
eng-docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/sla-isolation-migrate-4876
ci-bot: docs-lint failed: code-block language missing on SDK snippet; linkcheck found a dead anchor in /docs/dedicated/provisioning#reserved-pools (404 anchor)
rachel: i'll fix the anchor and add the SDK snippet language. Toni, can you add the integration test link in the PR and point to the runtime test harness?
toni: yup will add a small test under runtime/tests/eviction_policy_test.py and reference it in the PR description
alex: SDK snippet i'll add (python) — quick draft to include in docs:
```python
from redwood.dedicated import CapacityPool

pool = CapacityPool(reserved=True, eviction_policy="NO_EVICT", isolation_decorators=[{"tenant": "analytics"}])
client.create_capacity_pool(pool)
```
rachel: looks good, add a short note: "If you migrate from preemptible flags, map them to eviction_policy to avoid surprises."
toni: once tests land we should add a short regression check to the docs release checklist so this anchor/lint doesn't slip back in
alex: updated PR, pushed tests branch, tagging reviewers @rachel @toni for quick eyes. thanks! :sparkles:
